title: harper-wilson-sre-oncall-scratchpad-2026-03-12
content:
Quick notes from on-call shift (12 Mar 2026) - scratchpad

00:42 Pager: high-error-rate on hosted-api-prod-03 (5xx rate spike).
- Initial triage: spike correlated with model variant rollout for gpt-open-2-quant.
- Actions taken:
  - Scaled up replica count from 8 -> 12 for prod-03 (temporary) (noah action).
  - Rolled back last canary (traffic -> previous stable) -> error rate fell to baseline within 4m.
  - Opened JIRA SRE-512 to track root cause and follow-up.

Follow-ups (high priority)
- SRE-512: Investigate kernel selector regression when quantized models hit sequence lengths > 1024. Suspect edge-case in kernel fallback path that returns 500 instead of graceful fallback. (blocking for future rollouts)
  - Owner: Harper (me) to pair with Applied ML next week.
  - Linked PR: serving-runtime#987 (repro harness + fix in progress)

- Infra-234: Add additional metric and alert for "model_variant_rollout_error_rate" to avoid blind rollouts.
  - Suggested alert: when variant_rollout_error_rate > 0.5% for 5m AND affected_replicas > 2 -> page oncall-sre.

Post-incident notes
- Cause hypothesis: quantization kernel selection + new attention optimizer path leads to uninitialized buffer for certain seq_len distributions. Repro steps attached in PR.
- Short-term mitigation: stricter rollout policy (canary traffic cap 10%, min healthy check 3m) + autoscale buffer.
- Long-term: add unit test for seq_len 1024/2048 path in compilation layer.

Runbook TODOs (things I hit while executing runbook)
- runbook: "model-variant-rollout-failure" is missing a step for "force-rollback" cli command (we used internal script). Add exact CLI commands and permission requirements.
- runbook: clarify metric names (we had to search which "error_rate" tag to use). Standardize names across dashboards and alerts.
- runbook: include a quick link to the canary deployment console and to the specific model catalog entry.

Notes-to-self / reminders
- Add a small repro that sends seq_len=1200 tokens to quantized model to confirm fix locally.
- Follow up with Applied ML: schedule 30m on Mon 2026-03-15 to review kernel selector unit tests.
- Ask release-engineering to gate model catalog rollouts with new alert for next 2 weeks.

Other pages/alerts seen during shift
- 07:10 Minor paging: alerts for high tail latency (p95 p99) on dedicated-us-west pool. Root cause: noisy neighbor job on node gcu-22 (customer batch job).
  - Mitigation: cordon node, migrate workloads, and restart serving process. Created INFRA-234 for longer-term QoS work.

Open items (tracking)
- [ ] Add alert SLO for variant rollback failure (assign INFRA-234)
- [ ] Update runbook "model-variant-rollout-failure" (me)
- [ ] Write unit test for seq_len edge-case in compilation layer (pair with applied-ml)
- [ ] Postmortem draft for SRE-512 (start outline, due 2026-03-16)

Misc snippets / raw commands used during troubleshooting
- kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/model-serving --to-revision=42
- ./scripts/serve-repro --model gpt-open-2-quant --seq-len 1200 --batch 1
- curl -sS -X POST "https://console.redwood.example/api/rollout" -d '{"model":"gpt-open-2-quant","traffic":0}'

Questions / unknowns to resolve
- Did autoscaler metrics miss an important signal? need to check the autoscaler logs for the window 00:30-00:45. (Noah started collection)
- Why did the canary health check not mark unhealthy until error rate > 5%? Investigate healthcheck config mismatch between canary service and chart defaults.

End of shift handoff (to Sophia)
- Please pick up SRE-512 follow-ups and ensure repro runs on gcc-rt test cluster.
- Monitor variant_rollout_error_rate alert and escalate if reoccurs.
- Notes: rollback steps are in this doc + linked PR for context.

-- Harper
